title: DeterministicAIGateExtraction
description: Strict JSON contract for Stage 2 LLM text-to-JSON extraction. Do not compute totals, infer dates, or paraphrase quotes.

entities.description: Named people, organizations, or items copied directly from source text.

base.description: Exact starting number or fraction string extracted from text (e.g., '100' or '1/3').

multipliers.description: Ordered list of exact factor strings to multiply on CPU.

timeline_edges.description: Chronological [before, after] event pairs explicitly stated in the text.

quotes.description: Verbatim paragraph quotes copied character-for-character from the source.
